def testReindexAddHandlers(self):
    """ Add handlers adapt Product.Archetypes.interfaces.IBaseObject.
    This interfaces is not implemented by p.a.contenttypes in Plone 5.0.x.
    As a result, the DefaultAdder is used for all p.a.contenttypes content.
    The results for Plone 4.x and Plone 5.0.x should be consistent regarding the handlers.
    """
    self.folder.invokeFactory('Image', id='dull', title='foo',
                              description='the bar is missing here')
    # The results for Plone 4.x and Plone 5.0.x should be consistent regarding the handlers.
    if api.env.plone_version() >= '5.0':
        self.assertEqual(
            queryAdapter(
                self.folder,
                ISolrAddHandler,
                name='Folder'),
            None)
        self.assertEqual(
            queryAdapter(
                self.portal['front-page'],
                ISolrAddHandler,
                name='Document'),
            None)
        self.assertEqual(
            queryAdapter(
                self.folder.dull,
                ISolrAddHandler,
                name='Image'),
            None)
    else:
        self.assertEqual(
            queryAdapter(self.folder, ISolrAddHandler, name='Folder'),
            None)
        self.assertEqual(
            queryAdapter(
                self.portal['front-page'],
                ISolrAddHandler,
                name='Document'),
            None)
        self.assertEqual(
            type(
                queryAdapter(
                    self.folder.dull,
                    ISolrAddHandler,
                    name='Image')),
            BinaryAdder)
